entities.summary:
Pierre Job known professionnally as Hector Zazou was a French composer, arranger and record producer who collaborated with an international array of singers, inviting the likes of John Cale, Laurie Anderson, Siouxsie Sioux, 
Ryuichi Sakamoto, Jane Siberry, Björk, David Sylvian and Suzanne Vega.
